title: fix(spec)!: the presigned upload request declares a whole, non-negative size and a non-empty filename and mimeType
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao9ZLkgazHGbBtMatjZpT18B)_

Fixes #27598

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：预签名上传请求的 schema（`GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema`）现在声明 `size` 必须是非负整数（`int().min(0)`），`filename`、`mimeType` 不能为空（`min(1)`）；上传入口同时开始拒收小数字节数（400 INVALID_REQUEST）。
- 为什么改：公开 schema 原来接受负数、小数和空字符串，入口却拒收负数和空值，按 schema 写代码的调用方或 AI 会被误导；小数字节数更糟，入口会发出上传地址并写一条永远无法完成的待上传记录。
- 风险与回滚：负数、非数字、空文件名/类型的入口行为一字未改；唯一的行为变化是小数 `size` 从 200 变成 400，正常客户端发的 `File.size` 本来就是整数。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts`（三处收窄）、`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`（`isDeclaredByteCount` 改用 `Number.isInteger`）、`.changeset/27598-presigned-size-whole-non-negative.md`（BREAKING 说明与 ADR-0087 处置）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/storage.test.ts`，预期 73 个测试全过，其中包括 “refuses a fractional size, naming size”。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（等契约复审记录）。

## What changes

- `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.size` is `z.number().int().min(0)`, and its description reads "File size in bytes: a non-negative whole number (0 is an empty file)". The published JSON Schema now types it `integer` with `minimum: 0`.
- **Declared increment (same file, same declared-versus-enforced class, the #27887 precedent):** `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.filename` and `.mimeType` declare `min(1)`, described "(non-empty)". The order allowed this only if the door refuses `''` today. Measured on `main` `2e955dde`: the door's presence check `!filename || !mimeType || size == null` (`storage-routes.ts:968`) answers `400 INVALID_REQUEST` for an empty value of either key. The new door test below pins that reading.
- **Door (`POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned`):** `isDeclaredByteCount` asks `Number.isInteger(size)` in place of `Number.isFinite(size)`, so a fractional `size` is refused `400 INVALID_REQUEST` before any `sys_file` row is written. The refusal message now says "a non-negative whole number". Measured on `main` `2e955dde`: `size: 1.5` answered `200`, minted an upload URL and wrote a pending row. That row could never commit, because the complete door compares the held byte count (always whole) with the declared one (`heldBytesRefusal`, `storage-routes.ts`). Without this change the narrowed declaration would refuse a value the door still accepts, which is the same declared-versus-enforced gap in the other direction.
- `content/docs/references/api/storage.mdx` is regenerated (3 lines).
- Changeset `27598-presigned-size-whole-non-negative.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch and `@objectstack/service-storage` patch (the declared kind is `none`: a REST request declaration that no metadata type embeds is not authorable metadata, the seat's claim correction 6524182832 on #27598), `fix(spec)!`, both declaration lines, and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

The door still does not parse its body with the schema. Its presence check and byte-count check run before the scope gate, as #22470 requires, so status, code, message and ordering stay as they were for every value other than a fraction.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/api/storage.test.ts`:
  - `refuses %s, naming size` covers a negative size, a fractional size and a negative fraction. Each asserts `success: false`, exactly one issue, and `path` equal to `['size']`.
  - `refuses an empty %s, naming that key` covers `filename` and `mimeType`, with `code` `too_small`.
  - `CONTROL: size %d parses (0 is an empty file)` covers `0`, `1` and `1048576`.
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.test.ts`:
  - The #27413 refusal table gains `a positive fraction` (`1.5`). Every row now also asserts that `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.safeParse` refuses the same body.
  - `REFUSED 400 INVALID_REQUEST: an empty %s, which the declared schema refuses too, with no row written` covers `filename` and `mimeType` on this door. No earlier test sent an empty name or type here.
  - The `CONTROL` rows (`0`, `1024`) assert that the declaration accepts the body too.

<details><summary>Ablations: each narrowing turns its own case red</summary>

Each run used `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor hit once, and the file was restored to its HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- `size: z.number().int().min(0)` changed to `z.number().min(0)`: `× refuses a fractional size, naming size`, 1 failed / 72 passed (73).
- `.min(0)` removed from `size`: `× refuses a negative size, naming size`, 1 failed / 72 passed (73). The negative fraction stays refused by `int()`.
- `filename` `min(1)` removed: `× refuses an empty filename, naming that key`, 1 failed / 72 passed (73).
- `mimeType` `min(1)` removed: `× refuses an empty mimeType, naming that key`, 1 failed / 72 passed (73).
- Door `Number.isInteger(size)` changed back to `Number.isFinite(size)`: `× REFUSED 400 INVALID_REQUEST: size as a positive fraction, with no sys_file row written`, 1 failed / 74 passed (75). Before the door change, the same case failed with the door's `200` body, which is the measurement of `main` quoted above.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

The package runs below were taken on `bbd24a5f` / `6e328c49` (before the merge with `origin/main`). The storage suites were re-run on the final head `902d10c0`: spec `storage.test.ts` Tests 73 passed (73); `@objectstack/service-storage` Test Files 71 passed (71), Tests 1314 passed (1314).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 756 passed (756), Tests 22518 passed, 1 todo. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test`: Test Files 71 passed (71), Tests 1314 passed (1314). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage typecheck`: exit 0, and `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 1 of 14 stale (`content/docs/references/**`) before `--fix`. After `--fix` all 14 are up to date.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`: 1 declared-breaking changeset, carrying `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, reported to the seat and not filed:** the SDK's `storage.upload` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`) sends `mimeType: file.type`. A browser `File` of unknown type has `type === ''`, and the presigned door refuses that with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, so such a file cannot be uploaded through the SDK helper. This PR now also declares that refusal. The fix belongs in the client (send `application/octet-stream`), not in the door. Not measured end to end in a browser.
- A whitespace-only `filename` / `mimeType` is still admitted by both the schema and the door. The two agree, and this PR leaves that alone, as #27887 did.
- The claim writes `Clause-②: no`. The order and triage `6500594085` write `no (narrowing)`, and `check-changeset-no-major` treats `narrowed` beside a line without the `(narrowing)` arm as a contradiction. This body and the changeset carry `no (narrowing)`.

## Verification

All readings below are on head `902d10c0`, the branch merged with `origin/main` at `8cb8c7f461`, after a full `pnpm turbo run build` (116/116 tasks).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 109 commands (the same 109 before and after the merge). All 109 were run with stdin from /dev/null and the exit code captured before any pipe: 109 exited 0. On the pre-merge head, 4 first refused with exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no workspace build, and one self-test that needs an unshallow clone); after the build and `git fetch --unshallow` they exited 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE`: "109 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` on the merged head: all 14 generated artefacts up to date.
- Full dogfood (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock on `902d10c0`: Test Files 1 failed | 357 passed | 3 skipped (361), Tests 1 failed | 2882 passed | 20 skipped (2903). The one failure is not this change. `test/api-action-door-forward.dogfood.test.ts` > "the switch holds: ban_user OFF answers 409 ACTION_DISABLED through the door and the user is NOT banned" expects the `ACTION_DISABLED` message to contain `sys_metadata_activation`, and the message is now the plain sentence "This action is turned off for this deployment. ..." (`packages/objectql/src/action-activation.ts`). Both the test and the new sentence are already on `origin/main`, and this PR touches neither file nor anything they import from storage. Reported to the seat as a main-red candidate.
- CI on this PR: not yet read; the seat reads the check-runs.
